An '''unidentified reptilian-humanoid species''' dwelled in the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. One individual served as the [[Jabba's champion|champion]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] appeared to be [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] as they were capable of using tools and were seen wearing [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="E1VG" />
